liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out the first-set Bird Song as a fantastic highlight; First-set Bird Song is called amazing and intense [21][31][32]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Named among the highlights, along with Bird Song, Music, China>Rider, Terrapin and the US Blues encore [22]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): This source keeps the first minute of China Cat, which another board copy the reviewer had clipped [27]
- **Man Smart (Woman Smarter)** (1 review): Highlighted by the reviewer, with Brent standing out especially [29]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Terrapin is a highlight, with Brent prominent [29]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 other source): Listing shows El Paso following Little Red Rooster, where other sources list Peggy-O [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-10-18 s1t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd89-10-18 s1t02 Shakedown Street**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd89-10-18 s1t03 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd89-10-18 s1t04 Peggy O**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd89-10-18 s1t05 Queen Jane Approximately**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd89-10-18 s1t06 Bird Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd89-10-18 s1t07 The Music Never Stopped**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd89-10-18 s2t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-10-18.142562.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 170 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1989-10-18.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83776.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1989-10-18.147697.sbd.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 19 songs; 165 min [5]
- **gd89-10-18.nak.rob_r.7551.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 173 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [6]
- **gd89-10-18.sbd-matrix.nawrocki.12091.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 158 min; rated 4.06/5 by 16 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the sound quality of the tape is good; Reviewer finds this source muffled, rating its sound low; A heavy audience patch at the start of Shakedown may explain the harsh criticism of this source [22][25][27][29][30]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended this show and the preceding Meadowlands shows, and remembers it as their favorite of the run [22]
- Reviewer drove from Minnesota and learned of the San Francisco earthquake on hotel TV the night before; mix-position crew looked uneasy [24]
- Reviewer's third show; went without tickets at age 20 and got one with about twenty minutes to spare [27]
- Recorded from the taper's section, as arranged by Healy; posted to abgd via ArtCube [6]
- Overshadowed by the show two nights earlier; this one offers a standard setlist played with high energy [21]
- Sound is worse than the Alpine Valley shows of July 17 and 19, 1989 [25]
- Seen as a letdown after the Meadowlands show, though still solid [28]
- Reviewer considers the Rider solo at Alpine Valley that summer more unique and possibly better than this one [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-10-18.142562.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB)Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK4 mics @ 110 degrees, ORTF, Schoeps t-bar, hand held, chin high > Monster… [1]. Also: Recorded front-of-board with Schoeps CMC4/MK4 microphones onto DAT [1]
- **gd1989-10-18.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83776.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [4]. Also: Nakamichi 300 mics with CP4 and CP3 capsules to cassette master, then CD; tapes from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; Patch covers 1:41 in Drums to 6:21 in Space, recorded by Jill and Rob R [4]
- **gd1989-10-18.147697.sbd.miller.flac24**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [5]. Also: Schoeps CMC4/MK4 to DAT source supplies the Drums patch from 1:49 to track end; Charlie Miller mastered; Patch source was recorded by Ted Mattes [5]
- **gd89-10-18.nak.rob_r.7551.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Jill and Rob R; source: 3 Nak CM 300's - 2 CP 4's (Shotguns) 1 CP3 ( Super Omni ) [6]. Also: Audience recording by Jill and Rob R. with three Nakamichi 300s, two CP4 shotguns and one CP3 in X-Y pattern [6]
- **gd89-10-18.sbd-matrix.nawrocki.12091.sbeok.shnf**: source: Healy Ultramix > MC > DAT > CDR with Aud patches [11]
